purpose: Prevent safe but generic creative from becoming a release candidate while keeping every factual differentiator source-bound.

routing.reason: Story direction is a high-leverage judgment task; rendering and structural validation remain deterministic.
routing.below_threshold_action: Return the brief for better evidence or a different angle rather than escalating cost repeatedly.

rubric.scoring_rule: The story director supplies concise reasons per dimension; deterministic checks verify structure and lineage but do not pretend to judge excitement.
rubric.independence_rule: A score cannot override a hard failure, evidence gate, rights gate or exact-artifact review.

hard_failures: No source-bound difference, trade-off, change or insight supports the thesis.
Replacing the product or subject name leaves the story materially unchanged.
The hook depends on clickbait, false urgency, unsupported superiority or invented experience.
The story lists specifications without explaining an audience consequence.
The payoff does not resolve the opening tension or provide a meaningful next action.
A visual primitive is decorative and repeated without a narrative function.
Material caveats or comparison conditions are hidden to make the story more exciting.

measurement.optimization_rule: Optimize contribution and qualified audience value, not retention or excitement in isolation.
